dashboard.title: Today at a glance
dashboard.summary: Live health for the city: today's orders, SLA breaches, online delivery partners, offline restaurants and the alert feed.

live.title: Live order board
live.summary: Active orders sorted by risk, with filters and saved views, updated over the live stream.

orders.title: Orders
orders.summary: Search and browse all orders by code, phone, restaurant or delivery partner.

orderDetail.title: Order details
orderDetail.summary: Timeline, offers log, bill, parties and interventions: cancel, refund and manual assign, each with a reason and a preview.

dispatch.title: Unassigned deliveries
dispatch.summary: Deliveries without a delivery partner, and the manual assign panel with eligible partners by distance.

restaurants.title: Restaurants
restaurants.summary: Leads, the approval queue and all outlets with their health.

restaurantDetail.title: Restaurant
restaurantDetail.summary: Profile, KYC documents, menu, hours, commission versions, counter devices, payouts and suspend or reinstate.

riders.title: Delivery partners
riders.summary: Applications, the approval queue and all delivery partners with availability.

riderDetail.title: Delivery partner
riderDetail.summary: KYC review, training and kit, metrics, cash in hand, deposits and adjustments.

customers.title: Customers
customers.summary: Find customers by phone or order code. Phone numbers stay masked until revealed with a reason.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.summary: Coupon list with status and burn, and the create or edit wizard.

approvals.title: Approvals (maker-checker)
approvals.summary: Pending maker-checker requests with a preview; approve or reject. You cannot approve your own request.

payouts.title: Payout batches
payouts.summary: Weekly payout run: totals, exceptions, payees, mark paid with UTR and on-demand delivery partner requests.

zones.title: Delivery zones and fees
zones.summary: Zones, the polygon editor, zone pause or resume, and localities.

ticketDetail.title: Ticket
ticketDetail.summary: Thread, macros, order context and resolution actions.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.summary: Append-only record of every admin action with filters and before/after diffs.

reports.title: Reports and exports
reports.summary: Pick a report, start an export and download finished CSV files.

customerDetail.title: Customer
customerDetail.summary: Order history, flags and account actions.

payoutDetail.title: Payee statement
payoutDetail.summary: Statement lines for one payee, with links to the ledger.

pricing.title: Fee configuration
pricing.summary: Versioned delivery fee slabs with a simulator and an effective date. Changes need a second approver.
